I once saw a young owl, no older than a sparrow, sit on a branch and blink at me. I blinked back. It blinked again. I blinked again. Then it flew away, and I followed. We circled the meadow, and I saw it land on a fence post, then on a roof, then on a dead branch. It was playing, like a child. I think it was testing me. I think it was trying to see if I would follow. I did. And when it finally flew off, I followed, and I never saw it again. But I still think of it sometimes. It was a good day.
